title: bucket
description: An object store addressed by the S3 API. The vendor is not part of the configuration: an endpoint, a region and a path-style flag are enough to reach a cloud service, an in-cluster store or a test double, and a service that hard-codes one of them cannot be tested without it.

name.description: The bucket. It exists already: a service does not create its own store.

region.description: The region the bucket is in.

endpoint.description: Override the API endpoint. Unset means the SDK's own resolution for the region.

ca.description: Path to a certificate authority bundle the platform mounts, for a store whose endpoint is not signed by a public root. A store inside somebody's own network is the ordinary case, not the exotic one. Unset means the system trust store.

pathStyle.description: Address the bucket as a path rather than as a host. Required by most non-cloud implementations.

accessKeyID.description: The name of the variable holding the access key ID.

secretAccessKey.description: The name of the variable holding the secret access key.

credentialsEnv.description: The NAMES of the environment variables holding the credentials, never the values. Unset means the SDK's ambient credentials, which is what a workload identity provides.
